summary.headline: AIA Engineering Q2 FY27 sales flat at ~61,500 t; Q2 EBITDA ~INR361 crore on freight cost spike, management guides 25,000-30,000 t volume growth as internal goal for FY28-29.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 sales volume was about 61,500 metric tons against 63,600 t production, and H1 volume was about 126,000 t, roughly flat year on year. Q2 revenue from operations was about INR1,093 crore plus INR19.5 crore other operating income, with EBITDA of about INR361 crore and PAT of about INR249 crore, both slightly down year on year. Management attributed the decline mainly to export freight costs (freight about 10% of sales in Q2 versus a normal 7-8%), partly passed through in realisation per kg (up about INR1.78 per kg as stated). Management said the new value-added strategy (liners and NGDS grinding media) remains intact, with trials delayed or redesigned at some mines, and that it is internally targeting volume growth of 25,000-30,000 t a year from FY28, explicitly not as formal guidance.

segments.name: Mining
segments.commentary: Mining sales ~39,700 t in Q2 and ~79,000 t in H1, slightly up YoY and QoQ. One large mine stopped production for ~2 months in Q2, depressing dispatches to it.

segments.name: Non-mining (cement, thermal, others)
segments.commentary: Non-mining volumes fell ~12% YoY and ~14% QoQ; management attributed this to timing and said there is no structural issue, while acknowledging non-mining is not scalable or needle-moving.

guidance_outlook: Internal planning target of ~25,000-30,000 t volume growth per year in FY28 and FY29; management explicitly said this is not formal guidance and will firm up once confidence builds, possibly in the next one to two quarters.
Management described FY27 volumes as continuing flat; Mexico duty impact is said to be at the bottom with no further duty-related reduction expected.
Freight expected to fall toward 7-8% of sales from ~10% in Q2, though management said it is uncertain and not in its control.
NGDS volume ramp could be a top-up to the 25,000-30,000 t target; timing not committed. Second-half FY27 expected to show NGDS-plus-liner volume start, with grinding media to follow.
Ghana and China capacity expansion remains on hold for one more quarter; management will reconsider, hopefully by end of next quarter.
capex_capacity: H1 FY27 capex ~INR86 crore; H2 FY27 plan ~INR250 crore, largely for completing a corporate house land transaction, plus ~INR50-75 crore normal maintenance and incremental capex.
Ghana and China geographic capacity expansion on hold for at least one more quarter, with reactivation under consideration.
Two NGDS trials (one in Peru, one in Ghana): one mine trial delayed, the other sent back for redesign/reiteration; no outcome timeline given.
demand_pricing: Realisation per kg rose about INR1.78 QoQ/YoY as stated, largely from freight pass-through; part of the freight pass-through is expected to flow into Q3.

Order book rose to ~INR10.7 billion from a historical INR5-7 billion range, attributed to large orders received in the last month of Q2; contracts are long-term and management denied shipping-related bunching.
Mexico imposed ~50% duty on imports from many countries including India; affected volume was capped at ~7,000-8,000 t a year at peak.
Export freight and shipping uncertainty (Red Sea, Strait of Hormuz) is a friction point for South American customers; company is holding ~3 months more cargo on the water to mitigate delays.
Export benefit (other operating income) was described as the highest ever in Q2 despite lower volumes, reflecting timing between exports to the subsidiary and billing.

qa_highlights.question: Is mining volume decline due to tariff impact, and has the Chile order offset the rest of the mining business?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said mining is not declining now; volume was lost over the last 12 months due to Mexico's ~50% duty, and one large mine's stoppage for ~2 months also cut Q2 dispatches. Management called this the bottom and expects 25,000-30,000 t growth from next year.

qa_highlights.question: Does the 25,000-30,000 t target include NGDS, and is it independent of trial outcomes?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said more colour will come in a quarter or two; NGDS could be a top-up rather than the base. Growth is a mindset internally, not guidance, and trials remain important to the strategy.

qa_highlights.question: Why did EBITDA fall QoQ when realisations were flat per kg?
qa_highlights.answer: Freight costs spiked and could not be passed through on a spot basis; product mix also shifted (fewer other castings in Q2 than Q1). Management said part of the freight pass-through lands in Q3.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the non-mining volume drop of ~12% YoY and ~14% QoQ?
qa_highlights.answer: Management described it as timing between quarters with no structural issue, and said non-mining is unpredictable and not needle-moving; it suggested reviewing the annual picture.

qa_highlights.question: Is freight temporarily hurting competitiveness outside India?
qa_highlights.answer: Freight at ~10% of sales is abnormal; normal is 7-8%, and it is expected to ease. Management said the bigger issue is shipping uncertainty for South American customers, which adds friction to conversions.

qa_highlights.question: What is the order book jump to ~INR10.7 billion telling us?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it reflects some large orders received in the last month of Q2 under long-term contracts, not a dispatch logjam.

risks_watch: Freight costs: ~10% of sales in Q2 versus a normal 7-8%; whether it normalises in Q3 and how much pass-through sticks.
Mexico duty and US-linked trade actions; management called Q2 the bottom but gave no quantified recovery path.
NGDS and liner trial outcomes: one Peru/Ghana trial delayed, another redesigned, with no committed timeline.
Non-mining volumes down ~12% YoY; management's 'timing' explanation was not quantified.
Geographic expansion (Ghana, China) on hold; reactivation decision expected around end of next quarter.
Reduction in other non-operating income (~INR71.7 crore vs ~INR98 crore) and lower forex income in other operating income.
summary.management_tone: Confident on strategy and medium-term volume intent, but cautious and vague on timing: management repeatedly declined to give firm guidance, deferred trial outcomes, and attributed weakness to freight and temporary factors. Several answers were deflective on non-mining and the Mexico details, and the call started late with a dropped line.
key_quotes: We are not guiding this as a volume target, but this is what internally that we are working on and looks to be within the realm of possibility.
So it could be a top-up. We can assume that as a top-up.
It's already in that number. We actually feel that this is the absolute bottom for us.

growth.why: Management says FY27 volumes stay flat with Q2 sales ~61,500 t and H1 ~126,000 t, and the 25,000-30,000 t/yr growth for FY28-29 is an internal target explicitly not guidance; Ghana and China expansion is on hold, so backing is vague, with only a large late-Q2 order book (~INR10.7 bn) and freight pass-through supporting near-term revenue.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Freight at ~10% of sales in Q2 versus normal 7-8%, and management said part of the freight pass-through lands in Q3 and freight may ease, but it is uncertain and outside management's control.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Ghana and China geographic capacity expansion is on hold for at least one more quarter, with reactivation to be reconsidered around end of next quarter; no new plant timing given.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management says FY27 volumes stay flat (H1 ~126,000 t vs ~124,000-125,000 t last year) and the 25,000-30,000 t/yr growth is an internal target explicitly not guidance, with NGDS timing not committed.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: H2 FY27 capex plan is ~INR250 crore, mostly a corporate house land transaction, plus ~INR50-75 crore maintenance and incremental; utilisation level was not disclosed, so no new capacity capex is firmly signalled.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management described FY27 volumes as flat and gave no revenue or margin raise; Q2 EBITDA fell ~5% YoY to ~INR361 crore.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Freight normalisation is uncertain, Q2 EBITDA was down ~5% YoY, non-mining volumes fell ~12% YoY, and shipping disruption (Red Sea, Hormuz) adds friction for South American customers.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Management expects NGDS-plus-liner volume start in H2 FY27 with grinding media to follow, but two NGDS trials were delayed or sent back for redesign with no outcome timeline.

rows.label: Order book jump to ~INR10.7 bn
rows.why: Order book rose from a historical INR5-7 bn range to ~INR10.7 bn on large long-term orders received in the last month of Q2, which supports near-term revenue.

rows.label: Freight pass-through flowing into Q3
rows.why: Realisation rose ~INR1.78 per kg largely from freight pass-through, and management said part of this lands in Q3.

rows.label: Mexico duty at bottom
rows.why: Mexico's ~50% duty capped affected volume at ~7,000-8,000 t a year at peak, and management says the impact is at the bottom with no further reduction expected, but gave no recovery path.

tone.note: Management was confident on the long-term strategy and the internal 25,000-30,000 t/yr volume intent, but cautious and vague on timing, deferring trial outcomes and declining firm guidance; analysts pushed on non-mining volume decline, NGDS trial timing, freight-driven EBITDA fall and the order book
